using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        // We will test the TrySetSlotRangesAsync method focusing on the logger.LogTrace call on line 50 and 60.

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsTraceOnSuccess()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = new TestableMigrateSession(loggerMock.Object);

            // Setup client to simulate successful connection and "OK" result
            migrateSession.SetClientBehavior(
                checkConnectionResult: true,
                setSlotRangeResult: "OK"
            );

            // Act
            var result = await migrateSession.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.STABLE);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Sending CLUSTER SETSLOTRANGE")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("[Completed] SETSLOT")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsErrorOnSetSlotRangeFailure()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = new TestableMigrateSession(loggerMock.Object);

            // Setup client to simulate successful connection but "FAIL" result
            migrateSession.SetClientBehavior(
                checkConnectionResult: true,
                setSlotRangeResult: "FAIL"
            );

            // Act
            var result = await migrateSession.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.STABLE);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("SetSlotRange error")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsErrorOnOperationCanceledException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = new TestableMigrateSession(loggerMock.Object);

            // Setup client to throw OperationCanceledException
            migrateSession.SetClientBehavior(
                checkConnectionResult: true,
                throwOperationCanceledException: true
            );

            // Act
            var result = await migrateSession.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.STABLE);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("SetSlotRange operation timed out or was cancelled")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsErrorOnException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = new TestableMigrateSession(loggerMock.Object);

            // Setup client to throw generic Exception
            migrateSession.SetClientBehavior(
                checkConnectionResult: true,
                throwException: true
            );

            // Act
            var result = await migrateSession.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.STABLE);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("An error occurred during SetSlotRange")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        // Helper class to override dependencies and simulate behavior
        private class TestableMigrateSession : MigrateSession
        {
            private bool _checkConnectionResult;
            private string _setSlotRangeResult;
            private bool _throwOperationCanceledException;
            private bool _throwException;

            public TestableMigrateSession(ILogger logger)
            {
                this.logger = logger;
            }

            public void SetClientBehavior(bool checkConnectionResult, string setSlotRangeResult = null, bool throwOperationCanceledException = false, bool throwException = false)
            {
                _checkConnectionResult = checkConnectionResult;
                _setSlotRangeResult = setSlotRangeResult;
                _throwOperationCanceledException = throwOperationCanceledException;
                _throwException = throwException;
            }

            // Override client property to return a fake client
            protected override IMigrateClient GetClient()
            {
                return new FakeClient(this);
            }

            // Override CheckConnectionAsync to return configured result
            protected override Task<bool> CheckConnectionAsync(IMigrateClient client)
            {
                return Task.FromResult(_checkConnectionResult);
            }

            // Override client.SetSlotRange to simulate behavior
            private class FakeClient : IMigrateClient
            {
                private readonly TestableMigrateSession _session;

                public FakeClient(TestableMigrateSession session)
                {
                    _session = session;
                }

                public Task<string> SetSlotRange(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> stateBytes, string nodeid, object slotRanges)
                {
                    if (_session._throwOperationCanceledException)
                    {
                        throw new OperationCanceledException();
                    }
                    if (_session._throwException)
                    {
                        throw new Exception("Test exception");
                    }
                    return Task.FromResult(_session._setSlotRangeResult ?? "OK");
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class MigrateSessionLoggerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsTraceOnSuccess()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = CreateMigrateSessionWithLogger(loggerMock.Object);

            migrateSession.SetCheckConnectionResult(true);
            migrateSession.SetSetSlotRangeResult("OK");

            var result = await migrateSession.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.STABLE);

            Assert.True(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Trace,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Sending CLUSTER SETSLOTRANGE")),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()), Times.Once);

            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Trace,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("[Completed] SETSLOT")),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsErrorOnSetSlotRangeFailure()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = CreateMigrateSessionWithLogger(loggerMock.Object);

            migrateSession.SetCheckConnectionResult(true);
            migrateSession.SetSetSlotRangeResult("FAIL");

            var result = await migrateSession.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.STABLE);

            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("SetSlotRange error")),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsErrorOnOperationCanceledException()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = CreateMigrateSessionWithLogger(loggerMock.Object);

            migrateSession.SetCheckConnectionResult(true);
            migrateSession.SetThrowOperationCanceledException(true);

            var result = await migrateSession.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.STABLE);

            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("SetSlotRange operation timed out or was cancelled")),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsErrorOnException()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = CreateMigrateSessionWithLogger(loggerMock.Object);

            migrateSession.SetCheckConnectionResult(true);
            migrateSession.SetThrowException(true);

            var result = await migrateSession.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.STABLE);

            Assert.False(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("An error occurred during SetSlotRange")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()), Times.Once);
        }

        // Helper to create a MigrateSession with injected logger and override client behavior
        private TestableMigrateSession CreateMigrateSessionWithLogger(ILogger logger)
        {
            return new TestableMigrateSession(logger);
        }

        // Testable subclass to override dependencies and simulate behavior
        private class TestableMigrateSession : MigrateSession
        {
            private bool _checkConnectionResult;
            private string _setSlotRangeResult;
            private bool _throwOperationCanceledException;
            private bool _throwException;

            public TestableMigrateSession(ILogger logger) : base(
                clusterSession: null,
                clusterProvider: new TestClusterProvider(logger),
                _targetAddress: "127.0.0.1",
                _targetPort: 6379,
                _targetNodeId: "targetNode",
                _username: null,
                _passwd: null,
                _sourceNodeId: "sourceNode",
                _copyOption: false,
                _replaceOption: false,
                _timeout: 1000,
                _slots: new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<int> { 1, 2, 3 },
                sketch: null,
                transferOption: TransferOption.SLOTS)
            {
            }

            public void SetCheckConnectionResult(bool result) => _checkConnectionResult = result;
            public void SetSetSlotRangeResult(string result) => _setSlotRangeResult = result;
            public void SetThrowOperationCanceledException(bool value) => _throwOperationCanceledException = value;
            public void SetThrowException(bool value) => _throwException = value;

            protected override Task<bool> CheckConnectionAsync(GarnetClientSession client)
            {
                return Task.FromResult(_checkConnectionResult);
            }

            protected override GarnetClientSession GetClient()
            {
                return new FakeClient(this);
            }

            private class FakeClient : GarnetClientSession
            {
                private readonly TestableMigrateSession _session;

                public FakeClient(TestableMigrateSession session) : base(null, null, null, null, null, null, null)
                {
                    _session = session;
                }

                public override Task<string> SetSlotRange(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> stateBytes, string nodeid, object slotRanges)
                {
                    if (_session._throwOperationCanceledException)
                    {
                        throw new OperationCanceledException();
                    }
                    if (_session._throwException)
                    {
                        throw new Exception("Test exception");
                    }
                    return Task.FromResult(_session._setSlotRangeResult ?? "OK");
                }
            }
        }

        // Minimal stub for ClusterProvider to provide logger factory
        private class TestClusterProvider : ClusterProvider
        {
            private readonly ILogger _logger;

            public TestClusterProvider(ILogger logger)
            {
                _logger = logger;
            }

            public override ILoggerFactory loggerFactory => new TestLoggerFactory(_logger);
        }

        private class TestLoggerFactory : ILoggerFactory
        {
            private readonly ILogger _logger;

            public TestLoggerFactory(ILogger logger)
            {
                _logger = logger;
            }

            public void AddProvider(ILoggerProvider provider) { }
            public ILogger CreateLogger(string categoryName) => _logger;
            public void Dispose() { }
        }
    }
}
